name: SFG multi-finger soft gripper
summary: A configurable multi-finger soft robotic gripper from SRT for adaptive handling of irregular and delicate objects. This is a soft end-effector architecture rather than a rigid anthropomorphic five-finger hand.

description.en: A configurable multi-finger soft robotic gripper from SRT for adaptive handling of irregular and delicate objects. This is a soft end-effector architecture rather than a rigid anthropomorphic five-finger hand.

specs.label: Actuation
specs.value: Inflation bends fingers for adaptive grasping; evacuation reverses deformation for release or pre-grasp

sources.title: SRT SFG-SNM2-N4049 official parameter table
sources.quote: Realize bending deformation by inflating, cover the target object adaptively, and complete the grasping action; realize reverse deformation by pumping, complete the placing or pre-grabbing action
